name: hcapp_getRunActivity
description: What a run has to show, for the activity icons on a run card: whether a PackTrack track exists (HC.EventTrack), and how many photos the viewer may see, chat messages and down-down charges. Batched: the app sends the ids of the cards on screen.

parameters.name: eventIds
parameters.description: '|'-delimited HC.Event.id values; invalid entries are dropped, duplicates collapsed

rowsets.description: Only on auth failure: success envelope then error detail

rowsets.name: RunActivity
rowsets.description: One row per valid id, unordered.

columns.name: hasTrack
columns.description: 1 when HC.EventTrack or HC.EventTrackRunner has a row — at least one GPS point was ever stored for the run

columns.name: runnerCount
columns.description: Hashers with a row in HC.EventTrackRunner — how many runners recorded a track (0 for runs tracked before 2026-09-10 whose backfill found no runner rows)

columns.name: photoCount
columns.description: Photos not deleted, at Status >= 2 or uploaded by the viewer

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
